action.objective: Verify the reserved candidate f4f5 with a full-depth single-candidate search to confirm it is commit-ready.
action.rationale: Broad depth-2 search ranked f4f5 top (-50 exact) among all 35 roots, but no candidate is verified yet and commit_ready_moves is empty. reserved_verification allows 2000 nodes for f4f5 at effective_max_depth 4, covering a full root window plus mate/checking-chain probes. This uses the reserved allowance rather than the smaller analysis pool, and does not disturb the comparison reserve.
